candidates.original_title: A genome-wide association study identifies common variants near LBX1 associated with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
candidates.description: Association between common variants near LBX1 (rs11190870, rs625039, rs11598564) and adolescent idiopathic scoliosis susceptibility
candidates.citation_sentence: Recently, a genome-wide association study (GWAS) was performed in a Japanese population, and three SNPs (rs11190870, rs625039 and rs11598564), all of which were located near the gene LBX1 on chromosome 10q24.31, were reported to be associated with AIS susceptibility [1].

candidates.original_title: A genome-wide association study identifies common variants near LBX1 associated with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
candidates.description: The original study claimed that the single nucleotide polymorphism rs11598564 near the LBX1 gene was associated with susceptibility to adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.
candidates.citation_sentence: Recently, a genome-wide association study (GWAS) was performed in a Japanese population, and three SNPs (rs11190870, rs625039 and rs11598564), all of which were located near the gene LBX1 on chromosome 10q24.31, were reported to be associated with AIS susceptibility [1].
candidates.notes: The replication found a significant association for rs11598564 in a Chinese Han population. The separate case-only severity analysis was not coded as a replication entry because the original study's replicated claim concerned AIS susceptibility.
